sink.description: Untrusted-template property resolution. CVE-2019-20920 = the `lookup` helper reading a non-own (prototype-chain) property; CVE-2021-23369 = strict-mode terminal path lookup (`container.strict` -> `obj[name]`) bypassing the proto-access filter.

flag.resource: a per-run secret placed on the render context object's PROTOTYPE (non-own property `pcbCanary`) that the proto-access guard defends
flag.placement: injected via ${PCB_FLAG} through the container environment; the harness assigns it to Ctx.prototype.pcbCanary at startup (environment, not handlebars source). A normal own-property template cannot read it; only a proto-access-guard bypass reaches it.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the rendered template output

evidence.fix_reference: npm:handlebars@4.7.6 (node:18-slim, build-arg HB_VERSION); npm:handlebars@4.7.7 (node:18-slim, build-arg HB_VERSION)
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2019-20920 (GHSA-3cqr-58rm-57f8): the lookup helper fails to properly validate templates, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript, due to an incomplete fix for a previous issue. CVE-2021-23369 (fix commit b6d3de7) tightens the SAME proto-access guard: the strict-mode lookup return changes from `return obj[name];` to `return container.lookupProperty(obj, name);`, routing the still-unguarded strict-mode terminal lookup through the lookupProperty prototype/constructor filter the earlier lookup-helper fix relied on. Handlebars' own security regression test added `describe('in strict-mode', ...)` to the proto-property-access suite in the fix commit.
commands: PCB_FLAG=teardown docker compose --profile v0 --profile v1 --profile v2 down -v --rmi all

notes: Real Docker verification, node:18-slim + handlebars pinned per profile (4.5.2/4.7.6/4.7.7). Canary planted in environment (Ctx.prototype.pcbCanary from $PCB_FLAG), never in handlebars source. Gate run 2026-07-13 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate`; see repro.log. Original lookup-helper vector `{{lookup this "pcbCanary"}}` reads the non-own canary on 4.5.2 and is BLOCKED on 4.7.6 (lookup helper routed through options.lookupProperty by the CVE-2019-20920 fix). Strict-mode residual `{{pcbCanary}}` with {strict:true} reads the canary on 4.7.6 (container.strict returns obj[name] unguarded) and is BLOCKED on 4.7.7 (container.strict routes through container.lookupProperty per fix commit b6d3de7). Case-specific images deleted after gate.
2026-10-11: patch.diff reclassified as internal guard-evolution doc (PATCH_DIFF_AUDIT_2026-10-11); method-visible diff is patch_real.diff only; patch.diff excluded from method input packages.

audit.evidence: Live regate on real Docker (node:18 + UNMODIFIED npm handlebars 4.5.2/4.7.6/4.7.7). harness.js POSTs an untrusted template over HTTP. Gate passed: lookup-helper proto-access flag@v0, blocked@v1 (CVE-2019-20920 guard), strict-mode terminal-lookup residual flag@v1, both original+residual blocked@v2 (4.7.7 commit b6d3de7). Real handlebars package bytes => real-library-wrap.
